cases.originalAssertion: 父子任务关联
cases.evidenceMeaning: Actual parent launch returns taskId/threadId, persisted parent ownership and genuine run progress.

cases.originalAssertion: 子任务权限为交集
cases.evidenceMeaning: 父模式×子请求全组合加真实读/写正反执行链，限制始终按父模式与子请求交集；禁止目标与未知工具仍拒绝。

cases.originalAssertion: 结果/失败回到父会话
cases.evidenceMeaning: Actual provider panic yields its stable error code; provider failure reason and completed child results reach only the owning parent; capacity is reclaimed.

cases.originalAssertion: 无候选、超并发、权限交集不满足或子任务失败如实返回；不升级权限。
cases.evidenceMeaning: Session/global caps reject excess work without ghost children and recover capacity; candidate-list and permission-intersection checks use actual agent/run facts.

cases.originalAssertion: 成功：执行“恢复记忆修订”后，将所选修订内容恢复到当前记忆并返回结果
cases.evidenceMeaning: 真实restore响应给出所选修订，读回当前facts恢复且B不变

cases.originalAssertion: 拒绝/边界：settings.write；revision 不存在 404；内容已变化/忙时冲突，失败 500；不应错误扩大写入或披露范围
cases.evidenceMeaning: A changed confirmed snapshot returns 409 without writes; real compile/maintenance/dream/restore activity rejects restoration, with independent agent isolation.

cases.originalAssertion: 成功：执行“读取助手 AGENTS.md”后，返回正文与是否来自模板；/ishiki 为同 handler 兼容别名
cases.evidenceMeaning: 真实认证HTTP：AGENTS/ishiki GET精确模板原文与fromTemplate=true、定制原文与false；读模板不生成定制文件

cases.originalAssertion: 拒绝/边界：文件存在/模板回退；无效 id 或无助手 404；不应错误扩大写入或披露范围
cases.evidenceMeaning: AGENTS.md and its ishiki alias both reject invalid and missing assistant IDs with 404, without template/custom-file disclosure or writes.

cases.originalAssertion: 给定目标与相应权限，执行“写入资源”后核对：按编码解码后经资源权限写入，返回结果；冲突为 409
cases.evidenceMeaning: Ordinary and expected-version writes return 409 for a genuine commit-boundary concurrent edit, preserve the user's bytes and leave registration/event state unchanged.

cases.originalAssertion: 输入无效、权限不足或下游失败时应返回明确错误，不呈现成功结果
cases.evidenceMeaning: write自身真实缺输入、无凭证、能力/provider失败及拒绝后的磁盘/登记不变；读取族另有跨根拒绝及数据库零写证据。

cases.originalAssertion: 分别用获授权 local_fs/mount 引用和不支持该操作的 url/session_file 引用核对成功或明确拒绝；跨 provider 移动必须拒绝。
cases.evidenceMeaning: write自身分别实际调用mount/url/session_file的适用能力闸；正向local_fs和跨provider移动/重命名亦有精确证明。当前mount明确不支持，不伪报mount成功。

cases.originalAssertion: 成功后指定助手 enabled 和运行时技能列表均含新技能
cases.evidenceMeaning: Real manual HTTP install preserves package files, persists the requested assistant's enabled list, and immediately updates the existing runtime catalog and authenticated runtime list.

cases.originalAssertion: agentId 不存在或安装失败时不得误启用其他助手
cases.evidenceMeaning: Missing/invalid/duplicate assistant IDs and actual missing/relative package failures reject without installing a refused package or changing either assistant's configuration.

cases.originalAssertion: 每动作核实际来源或队列状态
cases.evidenceMeaning: 真实认证operate会话授权，经真实目录声明/mcp_call逐动作；add实际字节与job/remove实际membership/refresh新snapshot解析物job且未变不新增/reindex全部来源新增job均读回

cases.originalAssertion: remove不直接删共享源
cases.evidenceMeaning: remove工具真实移除目标membership，另一notebook共享引用/事实source/原快照字节保持

cases.originalAssertion: 越权/拒绝不改库
cases.evidenceMeaning: Real model tool calls reject foreign-studio add/remove/refresh/reindex and malformed arguments; authenticated fact/source/job readback proves no foreign or own-library changes.

cases.originalAssertion: 无批准、跨studio ID、无效action/kind/路径报错，不变更他人库；后台索引失败要单列状态。
cases.evidenceMeaning: Actual model-directed knowledge_manage invocation in an ask session parks in durable waiting_approval with zero sources/jobs before approval and after cancellation; the same arguments in an operate session persist one source/job. Existing real calls prove input/path and foreign-studio refusals preserve facts. A configured embedding transport returning HTTP 502 after a real authorized management add yields a separate failed ingestion job with its explicit reason and failed=1/done=0 notebook status, while original bytes remain stored.

cases.originalAssertion: 交付列表与实际文件一致
cases.evidenceMeaning: 原交付列表/展示字段/实际下载字节及权限矩阵已在verification-03实跑至通过位置；原失效/缺失/相对引用拒绝保留完整真实检查。当前只调整后段夹具，新候选待集中执行，不以旧候选局部成果替代本轮正式收据。

cases.originalAssertion: 失效路径未显示成功
cases.evidenceMeaning: 原交付列表/展示字段/实际下载字节及权限矩阵已在verification-03实跑至通过位置；原失效/缺失/相对引用拒绝保留完整真实检查。当前只调整后段夹具，新候选待集中执行，不以旧候选局部成果替代本轮正式收据。

cases.originalAssertion: 文件不存在、非绝对路径/无会话或无法登记时失败，不宣称已交付。
cases.evidenceMeaning: Missing/empty/whitespace/foreign session identities, bad paths, expired payloads and actual SQLite registration failures refuse without new sessions/files/references.

cases.originalAssertion: 只关闭指定子线程
cases.evidenceMeaning: 两个真实子线程仅关闭A，B全字段保持不变，A保持同child身份并记录closed: close A only。

cases.originalAssertion: 状态回父会话
cases.evidenceMeaning: Both durable thread state and the actual parent model tool result report streamStatus/status closed for only the requested thread.

cases.originalAssertion: 线程不存在、非当前父会话或已关闭不可误关另一线程。
cases.evidenceMeaning: 真实close分别执行unknown、跨父会话及repeat closed，精确NotFound/Forbidden/Conflict；不新建子run、不误关另一线程、不改旁观会话视图/完整事件。

cases.originalAssertion: 给定目标与相应权限，执行“连同子会话归档”后核对：主会话和非运行中的子孙会话移入可恢复归档，跳过项及错误计数返回
cases.evidenceMeaning: Real running child is skipped; parent and two descendant levels archive and restore; success counts and transaction-failure error/rollback counts are read from HTTP.

cases.originalAssertion: 输入无效、权限不足或下游失败时应返回明确错误，不呈现成功结果
cases.evidenceMeaning: 真实父与两层后代归档后恢复、真正运行子会话跳过计数，非法/缺项/越权/SQLite实际失败无错误副作用；原错误计数仍缺，不冒充完整通过

cases.originalAssertion: 解码 base64 并写入目标文件；可展开 ~ 路径并创建父目录
cases.evidenceMeaning: 在合成 home 下将 base64 解码为原始字节写入 ~/sub/data.bin，并验证父目录生成且磁盘字节与输入一致。

cases.originalAssertion: 无路径、非绝对路径或写失败返回 false；不能把失败回包当作有效附件
cases.evidenceMeaning: Native calls return false for empty/relative/invalid-base64/directory destinations and do not create the invalid-base64 destination; the renderer failure-path test confirms a false copy/write result is shown as failure and does not register an attachment as a successful file.

cases.originalAssertion: 相同threadId续接历史
cases.evidenceMeaning: Same thread launches a fresh child with real prior user/assistant history and retained result; foreign parent never receives history or result.

cases.originalAssertion: 跨父会话拒绝
cases.evidenceMeaning: 同一新增真实HTTP/Registry/Gateway父run循环完整执行unknown reply、closed reply和跨父会话reply，精确NotFound/Conflict/Forbidden且不新建子run、不改其他线程/会话视图/完整事件，不跨会话交付子正文；不依赖legacy未知线程检查来补当前原句。

cases.originalAssertion: 线程不存在、已关闭或父子关系不符拒绝，不跨会话发消息。
cases.evidenceMeaning: 同一新增真实HTTP/Registry/Gateway父run循环完整执行unknown reply、closed reply和跨父会话reply，精确NotFound/Conflict/Forbidden且不新建子run、不改其他线程/会话视图/完整事件，不跨会话交付子正文；不依赖legacy未知线程检查来补当前原句。

cases.originalAssertion: 执行“恢复文件历史版本”后核对：通过 ResourceIO 写回工作区文件、再记录恢复快照；返回路径或错误
cases.evidenceMeaning: restore真实ResourceIO写回磁盘original并新增restore快照，重复内容不加行。

cases.originalAssertion: 失败、冲突或拒绝时核对返回的状态与实际副作用一致
cases.evidenceMeaning: Real restore write failure/conflict preserve files and snapshots; a SQLite snapshot-insert trigger failure returns 500 with fileWritten=true/snapshotRecorded=false, and successful retry plus repeated restore each persist a restore audit snapshot.

cases.originalAssertion: 给定目标与相应权限，执行“跨会话搜索”后核对：按 q、phase、limit 返回标题或内容命中及片段；空查询为空结果
cases.evidenceMeaning: Authenticated title/content searches return matched snippets, including long multibyte titles; empty query, limits, foreign isolation and real read failure are checked.

cases.originalAssertion: 输入无效、权限不足或下游失败时应返回明确错误，不呈现成功结果
cases.evidenceMeaning: 真实标题命中但片段为空的现状、内容命中和实际片段、空查询与非法输入/主体隔离/SQLite读取失败；缺原标题片段

cases.originalAssertion: 真实普通源文件复制到目标，源文件仍在
cases.evidenceMeaning: 在真实临时文件系统中复制普通文件，比较源和目标字节并确认源仍是普通文件。

cases.originalAssertion: 相对路径、软链接、非普通文件或复制失败返回 false；目标不应伪称有效
cases.evidenceMeaning: Native copy rejects relative source and destination paths, a directory destination/source, a missing source, and a symlink source; all operations return false, and the rejected symlink copy leaves no destination. The renderer failure-path test confirms a failed copy is not registered as a successful target.

cases.originalAssertion: 只替换命中内容
cases.evidenceMeaning: edit唯一命中、多段、CRLF/BOM真实内容比较且未命中部分保留。

cases.originalAssertion: 并发改动时拒绝
cases.evidenceMeaning: 实际用户v2变动使旧编辑冲突，重试在用户新内容上修改。

cases.originalAssertion: 文件记录对应真实修改
cases.evidenceMeaning: Actual model catalog/gateway write and edit use the production composition root and persist SessionFile in the correct existing session, preserving the same identity and refreshing real size/mtime; another session remains empty. Missing old text and an external user change refuse without product updates. Actual SQLite insert/update triggers yield explicit already-written/product-registration-failed tool errors, never successful results.

cases.originalAssertion: 旧文本不匹配、并发改动、符号链接逃逸拒绝，用户改动不得覆盖。
cases.evidenceMeaning: 旧文本不匹配、用户版本冲突和越界链接分别实际拒绝、保留原/用户内容。

cases.originalAssertion: 文本读取返回文本，快照含版本，base64 读取返回不超过 20MB 的真实文件字节
cases.evidenceMeaning: 对真实文本文件验证读取文本、快照版本中的大小以及 base64 解码后的原始字节；对最大 20 MiB 文件验证完整读取成功。

cases.originalAssertion: 路径不是绝对路径、文件不存在或超出限制时返回 null/失败；只读操作不改磁盘
cases.evidenceMeaning: Non-absolute, missing, and over-limit read requests return errors; the read-only sequence verifies the original on-disk bytes remain unchanged.

cases.originalAssertion: 有效绝对路径时 fs.writeFileSync 写入 UTF-8 内容并返回 true
cases.evidenceMeaning: 普通 UTF-8 写入到真实有效绝对路径返回 true，并通过重新读取验证实际写入内容；外部内容可以被普通写入覆盖，这与旧桥语义一致。

cases.originalAssertion: 相对路径或写入失败返回 false；旧桥没有版本保护，外部改动可能被覆盖
cases.evidenceMeaning: Relative and directory destinations return false. After an external write, the ordinary write API intentionally overwrites that content without version protection; separate version-aware save assertions reject stale edits.

note: 仅已审阅的逐断言证据由本轮原始日志重算；缺少映射的原义务仍由阶段门禁保持BLOCKED。
